 Search Home New Top Charts Sign In July 21 Bill Ackman Predicts What's Next | An UNFILTERED Conversation The Western Spirit - With Ariel Whitman 41m Bill Ackman joins Ariel Whitman for a wide-ranging conversation on investing, artificial intelligence, Israel, Iran, Charlie Kirk, Warren Buffett, Donald Trump, the U.S. economy, and the future of America.Ackman explains why he remains optimistic about AI, discusses the stocks and businesses he's investing in, reflects on Warren Buffett's legacy, and shares his outlook on markets and long-term investing.The conversation also explores Israel's war with Iran, rising antisemitism, Charlie Kirk, the future of the Republican Party, Benjamin Netanyahu, the Democratic Party, Elon Musk, Neuralink, and why Ackman believes the biggest opportunities often emerge during periods of uncertainty.Bill Ackman is the founder and CEO of Pershing Square Capital Management, one of the world's leading investment firms, and a prominent voice on investing, business, technology, higher education, and public policy.Subscribe to The Western Spirit for in-depth conversations with world leaders, CEOs, investors, policymakers, entrepreneurs, and leading thinkers shaping the future.For business inquiries, including advertising opportunities on our show, please email us at: thewesternspiritpodcast@gmail.comChapters00:00Introduction and Guest
